product_name: München Tote in Diamond Jacquard
description: With our German birthplace as its central muse, the season’s Munchen tote is set apart by a multicolor jacquard-woven monogram drawing inspiration from the Bavarian diamonds. The signature silhouette is accompanied by a detachable leather logo charm in addition to a leather strap for hands-free wear.

product_name: Dia Shopper in Calfskin Leather
description: An artisanal companion with a Munich muse, the Dia shopper in calfskin leather is characterized by handle straps and side patches inspired by the Bavarian diamonds. Looking inward, emblematic artwork adorns the interior — featuring a removable pouch for another facet of functional brilliance.

product_name: Diamond Trilogie Crossbody Pouch in Monogram Mix
description: This mobile trifecta consists of a phone case, AirPods Pro pouch charm, and card holder. Mix and match the accessories on the Bavarian diamond-inspired handle, or wear them hands-free with the accompanying leather strap.
material: Maxi Visetos and Lauretos monogram canvas

product_name: Fursten Belt Bag in Monogram Nylon
description: A mobile masterwork in monochrome, the Fursten belt bag in black Italian nylon and leather epitomizes the sleek design ethos of the Munich House. Enveloped in the signature Visetos monogram, the striking silhouette is defined by a trilogy of zipped compartments.

product_name: Aren Crescent Hobo Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: As exquisite as its lunar inspiration, this curvilinear hobo bag in Italian full-grain leather is imprinted with a maximalist interpretation of the renowned Visetos monogram. Carry by its chain handle or attach the accompanying leather strap for hands-free sophistication.

product_name: Himmel Sequin Shoulder Bag
description: Silver and gold-tone sequins embellish the Himmel shoulder bag, accompanied by an elegant chain strap. The scintillating silhouette is accented with lamb leather and secured by the gilded Laurel emblem closure.
category: Bags > Shoulder Bags & Pochettes > Shoulder Bag

product_name: Aren Tote in Palm Canvas
description: The season’s tropical Palm Tree monogram radiates with the tonal warmth of a dream island destination. Featuring supple leather handles, the mini Aren tote is accompanied by a detachable herringbone strap for hands-free wear.

product_name: Aren Multi-Backpack in Visetos
description: A model of modularity, this Visetos monogram backpack employs the innovative design and artisan expertise of MCM to craft an all-encompassing travel companion. The silhouette features 3 detachable pouches, a removable belt bag, and a nylon compartment for smartphone and bottle storage.

product_name: Diamond Logo Crossbody in Metallic Calfskin
description: A bold nod to our German birthplace, the distressed geometric design of metallic calf leather crossbody bag is modeled after the Bavarian diamonds of Munich. The signature Laurel logo is embossed on the front of the silhouette, further complemented by a diamond-inspired metal hardware handle and adjustable leather strap.

product_name: Aren Duo Hobo in Maxi Visetos and Calfskin
description: A two-in-one design, melding modularity with exquisite leather craftsmanship. Sculpted from Maxi Visetos canvas and calfskin respectively, this detachable duet of hobo bags can be paired together or worn separately based on one’s needs and setting.

product_name: Aren Crossbody in Recycled Nylon
description: A sleek companion set off with classic codes, the Aren crossbody bag in Italian recycled nylon features a distinctive Visetos monogram printed mesh pocket. Supple leather details further highlight the impeccable craftsmanship of the Munich House.

product_name: Aren Boston Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: A refined carryall, born from the travel legacy of the Munich House. The Aren Boston bag is embossed with a maximalist interpretation of the signature Visetos monogram.

product_name: Aren Fabric Tote
description: Presented in a premium Italian cotton-linen blend, the large Aren tote is crowned with the renowned Laurel emblem of the House. Contrasting white leather details, including a detachable Bavarian diamond charm, elevate the structured companion.

product_name: Fursten Belt Bag in Palm Canvas
description: The season’s tropical Palm Tree monogram radiates with the tonal warmth of a dream island destination. Trimmed with ceramic blue leather, the Fursten belt bag features dual zip compartments for prized possessions. Wear around your waist in a classic fashion or across the body for a contemporary approach.

product_name: Diamond Clutch in Visetos Leather Mix
description: Channeling an eternal symbol of Munich, this small clutch bag features a calfskin front flap inspired by the Bavarian diamonds. Sculpted from Visetos canvas, the geometric design is accompanied by a leather chain mix strap for an elegant finish.

product_name: Color Block Terrain Sneakers in Visetos
description: The Terrain low-top sneaker is a lightweight style backed by exquisite craftsmanship and quality materials. Featuring a cognac Visetos monogram upper, the classic silhouette is refreshed with an infusion of jet black hues on the shoelaces, heel tab, and specially-developed rubber outsole. A padded leather tongue and calf leather inner lining finish off the pair, elevating wearer comfort through artisan sophistication.

product_name: Laurel Flat Sandals in Lambskin
description: These flat sandals feature an Italian lamb leather upper embossed with the victorious laurel emblem. Artisanal comfort is achieved through a lamb leather lining and leather sole.

product_name: Color Block Terrain Sneakers in Visetos
description: The Terrain low-top sneaker is a lightweight style backed by exquisite craftsmanship and quality materials. Featuring a cognac Visetos monogram upper, the classic silhouette is refreshed with an infusion of jet black hues on the shoelaces, heel tab, and specially-developed rubber outsole. A padded leather tongue and calf leather inner lining finish off the pair, elevating wearer comfort through artisan sophistication.

product_name: Mode Travia Loafers in Brushed Calfskin
description: Italian shoemaking expertise is expressed through a brushed calf leather upper, cognac calf leather lining, and lightweight Vibram® lug sole. The brass Mode Travia logo comprises the buckle, imbuing the pair with the structured splendor of the ringed emblem.

product_name: Ponte Varsity Jacket in Monogram Neoprene Jacquard
description: Drawn from the contours of our signature laurels, a monogram neoprene jacquard motif flows along the shoulders and sleeves of this oversized ponte jacket. Rib knit stripe details embellish the collar, hem, and cuffs of the varsity silhouette.

product_name: Jacket in Lambskin
description: An artisanal tribute to South Korean culture, this jacket in Italian lamb leather takes cues from traditional Taekwondo uniforms with a black-and-white colorway and a studded belt. Embossed renditions of the signature Visetos monogram showcase the meticulous craftsmanship of the House.

product_name: Jacket in Wool Twill and Monogram Print Leather
description: Woven from premium Japanese wool, this jacket is enriched by the classic codes of the House through signature Laurel logo embroidery, Visetos monogram printed leather details, and Bavarian diamond-inspired pockets. The cropped silhouette is finished with wide shoulders for an assured aesthetic.

product_name: Monogram Ripstop Nylon Puffer Jacket
description: Woven from Italian ripstop nylon, this hooded jacket is enveloped in the timeless splendor of the signature Visetos monogram. Insulated with recycled polyester, the padded silhouette fosters incredible warmth with respect to nature.

product_name: Aren Bifold Wallet with Card Case in Embossed Leather
description: Combining striking aesthetics with real-world utility, this leather wallet unfolds to reveal a color-blocked interior with classic compartments for your cards and cash. A removable card case adds another dimension of versatility and portability.

product_name: Aren Crossbody Wallet in Visetos
description: The Aren crossbody wallet showcases heritage iconography through an Italian monogram coated canvas body. Secured by metal snap closures, the nappa leather interior is fitted with a center phone compartment, a multitude of card slots, and side sleeves for cash and receipts. Carry the classic wallet as a clutch or attach the leather chain mix strap for handsfree elegance.

product_name: 38-41mm Apple Watch Band in Embossed Monogram Leather
description: Presented in natural full-grain leather, this Apple Watch strap is meticulously embossed with the classic letters, laurels, and diamonds of the Munich House. Combining craftsmanship and comfort, the supple band is finished with a metal buckle design inspired by the Bavarian diamonds of Munich.
category: Tech Accessories > Tech Accessories > Watch Strap

product_name: 42-49mm Apple Watch Band in Visetos
description: Sculpted from signature Visetos canvas, this Apple Watch strap features a supple leather underside melding craftsmanship and comfort. The band is finished with a 24k gold-plated metal buckle design inspired by the Bavarian diamonds of Munich.
category: Tech Accessories > Tech Accessories > Watch Strap

product_name: Diamond Buckle Reversible Monogram Belt
description: Emblematic of Munich, the Bavarian diamond serves as the centerpiece of this reversible belt’s matte black brass buckle. Showcasing two signature monograms, the accessory features a front face in Visetos canvas and an alternate side in Lauretos.

product_name: Suitcase in Visetos
description: Going back to the Golden Age of Munich, this hard-sided suitcase is emblematic of the jet-setting origins of the Haus. Sculpted from Visetos and Vachetta leather, the heritage travel companion is embellished with 24k gold-plated hardware and features a spacious microfiber suede interior.

product_name: Monogram Print Bikini
description: A highlight of our swimwear collection, this stretch bikini is embellished with the signature Visetos monogram print. The classic “MCM” letters bridge the bikini top through elegant logo hardware.
